in_sanskrit.name: Vijaya
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Vijaya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vijay' which means victory. It can also be interpreted as the one who overcomes evil or brings victory.

in_hindi.name: विजयपाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Vijaypal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijaya' which means victory. The second part of the name 'pal' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'palaka' which means protector or friend. Therefore, the name Vijaypal can be interpreted as the one who brings victory or overcomes evil and protects or is a friend.
